objects.name: Map Region Bucket via VLOOKUP
objects.description: Add a Region Group column via VLOOKUP(H2, Region_Lookup!A:B, 2, FALSE) against the Region_Lookup tab; unmapped region codes must be added manually and reported to Finance.

objects.name: Region_Lookup Tab
objects.description: In-workbook lookup tab mapping SAP region codes to region groups; can go stale when SAP adds new region codes.

objects.name: Power BI Desktop
objects.description: Used to open the .pbix file, verify/refresh the data source path, and publish to the Power BI Service.

objects.name: Power BI Service
objects.description: Hosted workspace destination all three dashboards are published to (e.g. Finance Analytics Workspace for Revenue).

objects.name: Refresh & Publish Revenue Dashboard
objects.description: Verify the data source path in Transform Data/Data Source Settings, Close & Apply, Refresh (~3-5 min; investigate if over 10), then Publish to the Finance Analytics Workspace.
